_readme: Per-repo translation POLICY for the shared i18n guards, read by
check-locale-coverage.ts and by both ingestion scripts via --policy.
Committed rather than passed on the command line: restating a rule
per run is how it becomes a reflex, and a flag people always pass
guards nothing.
requiredLiterals — strings the app compares TYPED USER INPUT against.
A locale that translates one renders a gate no speaker of that
language can pass. Enforced at ingestion because surfaces at risk
include apps with no coverage guard of their own (apps/defi's
recovery page compares against the same word).
omissions / empty — the narrow linguistic exemptions, bound to the
exact locale:key(:token) so each excuses itself and nothing else.
sameAsEnglish — leaves that legitimately read the same in every
language, so being identical to the English is not evidence of
anything. Deliberately short and each entry carries its reason: a
brand name and standard finance acronyms. Common UI words that
merely happen to be untranslated do NOT belong here — they go in
english-valued-baseline.json, which is meant to shrink. Two
categories need no entry at all because they are mechanical: a
string of only interpolation tokens, and a string with no letters.

ar:copy.units.durationDay_two.reason: Arabic dual encodes the count in the noun (يومان = 'two days'); restating {{count}} renders '2 يومان'

ar:copy.units.durationMonth_two.reason: Arabic dual encodes the count in the noun

ar:copy.units.durationYear_two.reason: Arabic dual encodes the count in the noun

empty.ja:copy.consentParts.prefix: Japanese puts the verb last; the suffix carries the agreement the English states up front

sameAsEnglish.copy.app.name: The product name. A brand is not translated.
sameAsEnglish.copy.desk.ticket.expiryGtc: GTC — standard order-duration acronym, used untranslated on trading surfaces in every locale.
sameAsEnglish.copy.desk.ticket.fillAon: AON — standard fill-type acronym, used untranslated on trading surfaces in every locale.
sameAsEnglish.copy.desk.ticket.fillIoc: IOC — standard fill-type acronym, used untranslated on trading surfaces in every locale.
sameAsEnglish.copy.desk.signed.rateLine: Two interpolations around APR, itself a standard finance acronym; there is no prose to translate.
